definitions.explanation: Prefix indicating something is from abroad or outside.
Prefix indicating the outer or external aspect of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外車|がいしゃ}→外車：19013_gaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{維持費|いじひ}→維持費：23066_ijihi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Foreign cars have high maintenance costs.

examples.japanese: {外|がい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{屈|く}しない→屈する：09142_kussuru⟧。
examples.english: I won't yield to outside pressure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外来|がいらい}{語|ご}→外来語：12101_gairaigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Foreign loanwords are increasing every year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外国語|がいこくご}→外国語：03023_gaikokugo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: Learning a foreign language is fun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外壁|がいへき}→外壁：06426_gaiheki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}える→塗り替える：06270_nurikaeru⟧。
⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}して→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: You shouldn't judge people by their appearance alone.

notes:
{外|がい}〜 is a productive prefix meaning 'foreign' or 'outside.'

- ⟦{外車|がいしゃ}→外車：19013_gaisha⟧ (foreign car)
- ⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧ (surgery - medical department)
- ⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧ (diplomacy)
- ⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧ (outward appearance)
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧ (going out)
